notes.Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries: This SME issue opens today and closes 27 Nov at Rs 130-142 per share, with no subscription data yet, so demand is unknown. All Rs 94 crore is fresh capital for the company. SME stocks have large lots, thin trading and big price swings, and no matching DRHP was found in SEBI's recent listing. One lot of 1,000 shares costs about Rs 1.42 lakh, too large for a small bet; wait for demand data before deciding.
